facts.anchor: Every time Kiamling tried to add a point, the officer held up the flat of his hand to her face. Archie was very close to challenging him to a pistol duel for the insult
facts.fact: 在惠灵顿道的中央警署，英国警官只听 Archie 结结巴巴的陈述；Kiamling 每次想补充，他就把摊平的手掌竖到她脸前制止——Archie 为这侮辱几乎要提出手枪决斗，随即想起 Kiamling 远比自己能应付。

facts.anchor: “So,” the original officer tapped his pen on the blank paper, “we are looking for someone who can summon Black Shuck, has made pacts with the fae and knows Merlin, right?”
facts.fact: 那名警官用笔敲着始终空白的纸，把他们的说法讥讽地归纳成：要找的是一个能召唤黑犬（Black Shuck）、与妖精订过契约、还认识梅林的人。

facts.anchor: “Kick these imbeciles out,” the officer said. “Honestly, we ought to tell the governor that one of his civil servants has been on the sherry.”
facts.fact: 警官下令把这两个“蠢货”赶出去，还说他真该去告诉总督：他手下有一名公务员雪利酒喝多了。

facts.anchor: Two Indian officers escorted them out of the building. The men recruited from India were often relegated to do the dirty work, disliked by the Chinese for being symbols of authority
facts.fact: 两名印度裔警员把他们押送出楼；叙述者说，从印度招募的警员常被派去干脏活，华人恨他们既代表权威又没有相应的富贵排场。

facts.anchor: “They might tell you to look the other way, to say it was sickness or opium, but you are no fools. What happened at Happy Valley, at Tai Ping Shan Street, cannot be explained by their so-called science.”
facts.fact: Kiamling 不肯罢休，边走边游说这两名木然的警员：上头会叫他们睁只眼闭只眼、把事情说成疾病或鸦片，但“你们不是傻瓜”，快乐谷与太平山街发生的事不是那套所谓科学能解释的。

facts.anchor: “My brother was attacked. He was patrolling the Mid-Levels a few weeks ago. Can’t remember a thing, but there are claw marks across his back that will not heal.
facts.fact: 较矮的那名警员瞥了同伴一眼，低声说自己弟弟几周前在半山区巡逻时遇袭，什么都记不得，背上却留下不会愈合的爪痕。

facts.anchor: Kiamling gave him her address, pressed him to send his brother for qi healing when he had time.
facts.fact: Kiamling 把自己的地址给了这名警员，催他得空送弟弟来接受气疗；几个欧籍文员下班路过，警员的表情立刻恢复成公事公办。

facts.anchor: He recognised the Chinese carpenter, Mr Leung. His team had built many of the colonial buildings, his harassed expression ubiquitous as he supervised half a dozen projects at the same time.
facts.fact: Archie 认出了那位华人木匠 Leung 先生：Leung 的队伍建过许多殖民地建筑，他总是一副被催逼的神色，同时监着六七个工程。

facts.anchor: The hammer in the carpenter’s hand drooped as if it would fall to the floor, his face turned momentarily towards the breeze from the window. Then he grimaced and shook his head.
facts.fact: 木匠手里的锤子垂下来，像要掉到地上，他的脸有一瞬转向窗外的风；随即他皱起脸摇头，说没时间，他得干活——此前 Kiamling 问他多久没休假、妻儿可好，他全答不上来。

facts.anchor: With that he turned his back, the hammering recommencing. Kiamling pulled Archie away. “He’s been cursed.”
facts.fact: 他转身背对他们，敲打声重新响起；Kiamling 把 Archie 拉开，断言“他被下了咒”，而 Archie 仍辩说他只是非常勤劳——Kiamling 反问：勤劳可不会把牙齿磨尖。

facts.anchor: “He’s turning into some sort of brownie or hobgoblin, perhaps? A house spirit from building all these houses.” A bitter laugh escaped his mouth.
facts.fact: Archie 把话挤出来：Leung 也许正变成某种棕仙或家精（brownie、hobgoblin），因盖了这么多房子而成了屋灵；说完他发出一声苦笑。

facts.anchor: “It’s Governor Bowring or Reverend Nairns,” Kiamling interrupted. “It has to be. Men of power who want to eliminate the community leaders. To start a war, although I am not certain how this starts a war exactly…”
facts.fact: Kiamling 打断他，断定幕后是总督 Bowring 或 Nairns 牧师：有权势的人要除掉社区领袖，为的是挑起一场战争——尽管她也不确定这怎么就引发战争。

facts.anchor: Por Por, Barrister Ng, Madam Yau and now Foreman Leung. They were not at the laying of the foundation stones of the Man Mo temple simply by accident. Each is a pillar of the community. Targeted for that reason.”
facts.fact: 她列出 Por Por、Ng 大律师、Yau 夫人，如今又加上 Leung 工头：这些人出现在文武庙奠基礼上绝非偶然，每一个都是社区支柱，正因此被针对。

facts.anchor: “We will go to the cathedral. Confront Reverend Nairns. I need to look him in the eye. I’ll know if he’s lying.”
facts.fact: Kiamling 决定去大教堂当面质问 Nairns 牧师：她必须直视他的眼睛，就能看出他有没有撒谎。

facts.anchor: “No, it needs to be tonight.” She was riled up, re-energised by the sleep and the soup Hoi had made her.
facts.fact: 她拒绝等到明天，坚持必须今晚就去——Hoi 给她准备的睡眠和汤让她重新有了精神，她要赶在对方察觉、事情变得更糟之前。

facts.anchor: “Jingling shouldn’t come anyway, it’s too dangerous. And Hoi gor disapproves. Let’s go. Just you and me.”
facts.fact: 她说不该让 Jingling 去，太危险，Hoi 哥也不赞成，就她和 Archie 两个人去。

facts.anchor: He extended his hand, forever the gentleman. This time she took it. Archie’s eyebrow quirked, surprised.
facts.fact: Archie 伸出手——他一贯的绅士做派；这一次 Kiamling 握住了，他惊讶地挑了挑眉。

facts.anchor: It was too late for him. It had been from the moment he had crashed into her outside St John’s all those months ago. The hunger within him would not be sated.
facts.fact: Archie 明白自己已经太迟：从几个月前在圣约翰堂外撞上她那一刻起就已如此，他内里的那股“饥饿”再也不会被餍足。
